thread:
maya: FYI preflight eval gate just flagged summarizer v2.3.0 on EU route — prompt-suite delta +4.7% (regression). Seeing failure modes on long-form summarization prompts.

deploybot: PREDEPLOY CHECK — Eval gate FAILED for model summarizer:v2.3.0 (route: eu). Metric: prompt-suite-quality delta = +4.7% (threshold 3.0%). Sample link: https://evals.internal/reports/1765439999
jordan: Copy. Can someone paste a couple failing examples? want to eyeball quick.

qa-bot: Summary: 42/100 samples degraded; top failure buckets: hallucination increase (18), truncation on long inputs (12), formatting regressions (12). Top diffs attached in report above. Use `evals diff --run 1765439999 --top 10`
samir: If it's primarily EU route traffic and localized to long-form, we can consider pinning EU to summarizer:v2.2.9 while letting global continue. That buys time for a proper bisect.

ana: @samir (ana) -- i think product needs impact estimate. How many users might hit long-form EU in the next 24h? any SLO/metrics alerting triggered?
maya: No SLO alerts yet. Estimated affected sessions ~1.2k/day (EU long-form). Degradation is visible in our manual checks but not server-side latency.
tyler: Oncall suggests: partial pin EU route to v2.2.9 now to stop regressions, then if root cause quick we can push a hotpatch to v2.3.1. If hotpatch looks risky, keep pin until bisect completes.
jordan: Agree. Who needs to approve route pin? Is product-ops ok with partial rollback? we should also update release notes to mention the temporary pin and follow-up.

product-ops: Approving partial pin to EU only. Please create ticket for hotpatch/bisect and add owners (samir/jordan/qa). Also update release notes with notes under \"Known Issues\" and link to eval report.

maya: I'll open the ticket and draft a short release-note patch. Draft note: \"Temporary pin: EU summarizer traffic routed to v2.2.9 due to prompt-suite regression observed in v2.3.0. We are investigating; no latency or availability impact.\"

jordan: Can ops run the pin? deploybot, run pin command for route eu -> summarizer:v2.2.9 with change window 'immediate' and annotate with ticket #RL-792.

deploybot: COMMAND RECEIVED: `deploybot route pin --route eu --model summarizer:v2.2.9 --annotation \"RL-792 partial pin for eval regression\" --change-window immediate`
deploybot: ACTION — Route pin applied. EU traffic now routed to summarizer:v2.2.9. Rolling config change id: rc-2026-1765440100.

qa-bot: Quick re-run after pin: prompt-suite delta (eu) = +0.3% (within threshold). Global (unrouted) still shows +4.6%.
maya: Good — EU pass confirmed. Leaving global alone for now so we can bisect without losing coverage. Samir, please start bisect + heap of regressions and check tokenizer/quantization changes in v2.3.0.
samir: On it — starting bisect now, will post findings in this thread. If I find a clear kernel/quant issue, i'll propose a hotpatch to v2.3.1; otherwise we'll keep the pin until root cause fixed.

jordan: I'll update the release notes and notify external stakeholders (docs and support) with the short statement.

product-ops: Noted. Postmortem/retro scheduled for tomorrow 10:00 UTC; add an agenda item to review preflight sample coverage and whether our prompt-suite needs expansion for long-form cases.

maya: Thanks all. Quick checklist captured in ticket RL-792: 1) pin applied (done) 2) bisect in progress (samir) 3) release-notes update (jordan) 4) hotpatch decision by 6h from now (owner: samir) 5) postmortem scheduled.

ana: :thumbsup: ping me when you have the bisect artifact; product will decide on wider rollback if user impact increases.

maya: Will do. Closing loop here but keeping thread open for bisect updates.
